fields.name: OrleansDbQueryDefinitions query-definition library surface
fields.contract: OrleansDbQueryDefinitions constructs the persistence-query definition for one grain identifier. Its constructor family accepts a result format and exactly one representation for each of the read, write, and clear roles: an eager QueryProcedure or a deferred Lazy<QueryStatement>. The eight overloads cover every independent eager/deferred combination across those three roles.
